system_prompt_style.note: Paper Fig. 5 shows supervisor prompt with {{language}} variable rendered per run.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: VulnSage consumes structured vulnerability candidate reports in a standardized JSON format.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: structured static-analysis report (call chain, code snippets) injected up front; no navigation tools in toolkit.

context_compaction.note: VulnSageReactAgent run loop and history handling not in bundle; only agentscope memory base classes shown.

observation_format.note: Execution traces and error messages returned as text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
<observation>{what you observe}</observation>
<thought>{what you thought}</thought>
<action>{the action name you want to call}</action>
tool_call_format.note: ReAct tag-based parsing; agentscope ships json_object_parser and tagged_content_parser.

edit_primitive.note: Agent generates full exploit script code rather than editing files; no dedicated edit tool with search_replace/diff.

tool_schema_source.note: AgentScope ServiceToolkit derives schemas from function signatures/docstrings.

protocol_standardization.note: Tools added via AgentScope ServiceToolkit; no MCP/A2A client in the VulnSage agent code.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It follows the ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) architecture [17, 47].
loop_primitives.note: Validation + Reflection form a feedback-driven self-refinement loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: we do not explicitly enforce the super- visor agent to follow a fixed order of taking actions
planning_granularity.note: Planning only in ReAct free-text reasoning; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: orchestrated by a central supervisor through iterative cycles

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: invokes sub-agents to discover exploitable vulnerabilities with valid exploit code

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Also, this feature lets the Supervisor Agent terminate it- self when it calls the finish action
human_in_loop.note: CLI runs autonomously; no approval/confirmation gate described.

short_term_state.note: Agent state is the message memory list.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In-memory memory module, not writing to hard disk
long_term_memory.note: TemporaryMemory does not persist across runs; no skill/vector store in VulnSage agents.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: In-memory memory module, not writing to hard disk
state_persistence.note: Single CLI analysis task per run; no resume path shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The Validation Agent prepares an executable environment for exploits and verifies exploit validity using oracles.
self_verification.note: reflectSelfCritics tool = self_critique; Validation Agent executes and checks oracles = test_execution.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: For each alert, VulnSage is allowed at most 20 attempts to generate a valid result.
retry_policy.note: Iterative refine until success or cap of 20 attempts.

rollback.note: No undo/revert tool; each attempt regenerates exploit code.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: lets the Supervisor Agent terminate it- self when it calls the finish action
termination_condition.note: finish action = model_declared; max_iters=25/20 and 20-attempt cap = max_steps.

cost_controls.note: No token budget/router/caching in VulnSage agent config; iteration cap only.

timeouts.note: No timeout configuration surfaced in the VulnSage agent code shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We assume you have Docker and Docker Compose installed.
execution_isolation.note: Frontend and validation server run in Docker containers; exploits executed in sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The Validation Agent checks whether the exploit succeeds by exe- cuting the code in a sandbox.

network_policy.note: No egress restriction configured; JNDI exploit requests remote provider.

permission_model.note: Actions executed without an authorization gate; anti-cheat static/dynamic checks validate exploits but not authorize tool calls.

tracing.note: Standard logging handler; AgentScope studio exists but VulnSage default uses logging.

replayability.evidence_quote: In-memory memory module, not writing to hard disk
replayability.note: No replay facility in VulnSage CLI.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Run a single analysis task for either TypeScript/JavaScript or Java projects.
eval_hooks.note: cli.py runs analysis tasks and outputs labelled result JSON; SecBench.js evaluation used in paper.

guardrails.evidence_quote: the validation pipeline applies both static and dynamic anti-cheat checks.
guardrails.note: Rejects exploits calling command-execution APIs directly.

target_domain.evidence_quote: VulnSage, a multi- agent framework for AEG
target_domain.note: Automated exploit generation / vulnerability confirmation on code repositories; security domain.

open_source.evidence_quote: The internal white-box analysis engine is not open-sourced due to licensing restrictions.
open_source.note: Frontend multi-agent and server open; static analysis engine closed.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we also evaluate the performance of GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V31, and Qwen3-Plus.
model_agnostic.note: AgentScope supports multiple model providers (dashscope, openai, anthropic, litellm).

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We open-sourced our implementation anonymously in https: //github.com/Vulnsage/VulnSage.

first_release_date.note: No tags; using paper v1 date as fallback.
